name: Bennewitz.Ninja Kestrel web site
//sourceName: -n takes the site's name, e.g. -n Gallery, which becomes the assembly and executable name.
Namespaces carry Bennewitz.Ninja. from Directory.Build.props, as in every family repository.

RepoOwner.description: GitHub account or organisation the generated repository lives under.

//RepoName: A site's repository is usually named after the site, unprefixed, unlike a package
repository, which carries Bennewitz.Ninja. like its package id. So it defaults to -n.

RepoName.description: The GitHub repository's name, when it is not the site's name.

Blazor.description: Adds interactive server components embedded in the MVC views, with a test that renders one. Off by default: a render mode and a circuit are more than a site needs on its first day.
